sloka: ददामि ते महाबाहो ब्राह्मम् अस्त्रम् अनुत्तमम् ।गदे द्वे चैव काकुत्स्थ मोदकी शिखरी शुभे ॥१-२७-७॥
transliteration: dadāmi te mahābāho brāhmam astram anuttamam ।gade dve caiva kākutstha modakī śikharī śubhe ॥1-27-7॥

translations.english: Born in the race of kakutstha and a tiger among men, O Rama I shall also grant two shining maces known as modaki and shikhari.
